name: Base64
tagline: Turn text or files into Base64, and back.
description: Encode or decode Base64 for text and files, standard or URL-safe, with full UTF-8 support. Free, and nothing leaves your browser.

specs.Text: UTF-8, so emoji and all languages work
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. Encoding happens in this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere. Safe for tokens and keys.
The same encoding with - and _ instead of + and /, and no = padding, so it can sit in a web address or a JWT.
